rationale: Followed the brief's scene in the white/off-white/grey palette; light set to upper-left to match the real pack shots. Props, tints and textures kept in outer or lower areas so the copy and photo zones stay empty. Situation briefs evoke the moment without people or product.

variants.axis_value: Off-white bathroom shelf corner, pale grey tile edge, morning light
variants.image_prompt: Create a photographic background image: a straight-on view of a quiet off-white #F4F2EE bathroom shelf corner with a pale grey #E5E9EA tile edge running along the bottom of the frame, the shelf empty, evoking a morning bathroom counter. Lighting: soft morning daylight from the upper left at 5600K, shadows falling to the lower right. Background: matte tile, matte off-white wall, shallow depth. Style: bathroom shelf restraint, uncluttered, single light source. The left half of the frame is intentionally empty, an even low-detail field for headline copy added later. The right 45% of the frame is intentionally empty, an evenly lit open area reserved for a photo placed later. The bottom quarter of the frame stays plain and calm. Square 1:1, 1024x1024, 50mm lens at f/8 so the whole surface is sharp, fine photographic detail, no film grain. Do not include: any text, letters, numbers, logos, product, bottle, tube, packaging, people, faces, skin, hands.
variants.negative_prompt: Do not include: any text, letters, numbers, logos, product, bottle, tube, packaging, people, faces, skin, hands.

asset_requirements: real pack shot composited by the tool
